name: Kunming urban transect A-B
selection_basis: A descriptive NW-SE urban transect through the main built-up area, Guandu and Chenggong. Vertices were selected from building coverage and the existing map, without optimizing risk values. This is an illustrative urban axis, not a surveyed road centerline or a fault-normal profile. Half-width and segment length were adjusted for sample coverage; the route was frozen before reporting risk summaries.

additional_transects.name: Dian Lake to the vicinity of the 2026 earthquake
additional_transects.selection_basis: A straight crossing transect from the nearest point on the 2016 Dian Lake reference shoreline to the target 102.672 E, 25.023 N, towards the vicinity of the user-supplied 2026 epicenter at 102.73 E, 25.09 N. D is about 0.94 km southwest of the epicenter to preserve its original map symbol. Geographic endpoints were fixed before inspecting risk summaries.
